title: 轉乘車站垂直動線~Vertical circulation in interchange stations
focus: 轉乘樓層高差通道分流與等候整合~Transfer-level changes route splitting and waiting integration
summary: 本課聚焦轉乘樓層高差通道分流與等候整合。從樓梯出口有效淨寬建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把扶梯下端積壓與垂直運輸往返節拍連成可驗證的介面，最後以跨層動線驗證安排整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies transfer-level changes route splitting and waiting integration. Start with effective width at stair exits to define physical or information boundaries, connect accumulation at escalator landings with round-trip vertical-service cycle as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through planning multilevel route verification. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1991 年一九八五年緊急整備指南於該年重印。；2015 年地下車站旅客流研究報告於該年出版。；2025 年臺灣鐵道車站概念設計指引函頒。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對轉乘樓層高差通道分流與等候整合而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用跨樓層轉乘時間及電梯停用替代路徑連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 1991: The rail-transit emergency guide originally published in nineteen eighty-five was reprinted. 2015: A study of underground-station passenger flow was published. 2025: Taiwan issued guidance for conceptual railway-station design. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For transfer-level changes route splitting and waiting integration, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through travel time between levels and alternative routes during lift outages. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究樓梯出口有效淨寬。原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。敏感度只改 width=2.4 至 2.64 m，輸出變為 2.904 persons/s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究跨樓層轉乘時間：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元辨認樓梯、扶手與下游門口的最窄斷面，檢查雙向人流是否共用同一有限寬度。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate effective width at stair exits. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. For sensitivity, change only width=2.4 to 2.64 m; the output becomes 2.904 persons/s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate travel time between levels: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Locate the narrowest section among stairs, handrails and downstream doors, checking whether opposing flows share the same limited width. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 樓梯出口有效淨寬~Effective width at stair exits
units.title: 樓梯出口有效淨寬~Effective width at stair exits
units.mechanism: 本單元辨認樓梯、扶手與下游門口的最窄斷面，檢查雙向人流是否共用同一有限寬度。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。單位寬流率是情境參數，受方向、坡度與群體能力影響；多條通道的容量只有在下游沒有共同瓶頸時才能直接相加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。~Locate the narrowest section among stairs, handrails and downstream doors, checking whether opposing flows share the same limited width. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance. Specific flow is scenario dependent and varies with direction, slope and user capability. Parallel passage capacities may be added only when they do not share a downstream bottleneck. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.
units.verify: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。以「樓梯出口有效淨寬」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. For effective width at stair exits, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 以建築軸線寬度代替淨寬會高估容量，出口匯流也可能讓上游兩條通道互相阻塞。回到「樓梯出口有效淨寬」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Using structural width instead of clear width overstates capacity; merging exits can make two upstream passages obstruct each other. Trace the input chain for effective width at stair exits. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加~Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
units.practice: 只把有效淨寬 width 從 2.4 改成 2.64 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.64 變為 2.904 persons/s。先說明「樓梯出口有效淨寬」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only effective clear width width from 2.4 to 2.64 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.64 to 2.904 persons/s. Explain the causal direction for effective width at stair exits, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 跨樓層轉乘時間~Travel time between levels
units.title: 跨樓層轉乘時間~Travel time between levels
units.mechanism: 本單元將長距離步行與電梯等待分開記錄，對照不同轉乘路線的可達性和到達時間分布。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。坡道、門扇與轉乘決策都可能造成停頓；對行動受限旅客而言，較遠但連續可達的路徑往往比短而不連續的路徑更可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。~Record long walking segments separately from elevator waits, comparing accessibility and arrival-time distributions across transfer routes. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone. Ramps, doors and transfer decisions can introduce pauses. For a mobility-limited traveller, a longer continuously accessible route can be more usable than a shorter route containing an inaccessible interruption. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.
units.verify: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。以「跨樓層轉乘時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. For travel time between levels, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。回到「跨樓層轉乘時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Trace the input chain for travel time between levels. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑~The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
units.practice: 只把假想步速 speed 從 0.8 改成 0.88 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 185 變為 171.364 s。先說明「跨樓層轉乘時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only assumed walking speed speed from 0.8 to 0.88 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 185 to 171.364 s. Explain the causal direction for travel time between levels, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 高差與坡道路徑~Level changes and ramp routes
units.title: 高差與坡道路徑~Level changes and ramp routes
units.mechanism: 本單元用端點高程與水平距離檢查坡道幾何，另外保留平台、轉向空間與排水造成的局部橫坡。坡度以高差除以水平長度定義，不能把斜面長度直接當分母。平均坡度之外還要檢查平台、橫坡與轉折，因為輪椅使用者在坡道終端需要轉向與停止的空間；符合一個幾何比值並不代表整條無障礙路徑連續可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。~Check ramp geometry using endpoint elevations and horizontal run, while separately retaining landings, turning space and drainage-related local cross-slope. Slope uses rise divided by horizontal run, not sloping surface length. Landings, cross-slope and transitions also matter because wheelchair users need space to turn and stop. Meeting one geometric ratio does not establish continuous usability of an accessible route. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。公式 y=rise/run*100，代入得 y=6 percent。邊界：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m. Formula y=rise/run*100 gives y=6 percent. Boundary: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit.
units.verify: 以同一高程基準量端點，再沿行走路徑抽測局部坡度、橫坡與平台平整度。以「高差與坡道路徑」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Survey endpoints on one elevation datum, then sample local slope, cross-slope and landing level along the route. For level changes and ramp routes, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 兩端平均坡度合格仍可能隱藏短距離陡坡，排水沉陷又可能造成輪椅偏向。回到「高差與坡道路徑」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~An acceptable endpoint average can hide a short steep segment, while drainage settlement can introduce a destabilizing cross-slope. Trace the input chain for level changes and ramp routes. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡~An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
units.practice: 只把水平長度 run 從 7.5 改成 8.25 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變為 5.45455 percent。先說明「高差與坡道路徑」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only horizontal run run from 7.5 to 8.25 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 6 to 5.45455 percent. Explain the causal direction for level changes and ramp routes, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 扶梯下端積壓~Accumulation at escalator landings
units.title: 扶梯下端積壓~Accumulation at escalator landings
units.mechanism: 本單元追蹤下游突然降速造成的等候存量，避免只用扶梯運轉速度推論落地區可以承受人流。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。~Track waiting occupancy when downstream movement slows, avoiding inference of landing capacity from escalator running speed alone. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
units.verify: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。以「扶梯下端積壓」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. For accumulation at escalator landings, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「扶梯下端積壓」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for accumulation at escalator landings. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊~Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
units.practice: 只把觀察時間 duration 從 120 改成 132 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 72 變為 79.2 persons。先說明「扶梯下端積壓」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only observation duration duration from 120 to 132 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 72 to 79.2 persons. Explain the causal direction for accumulation at escalator landings, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 電梯等候平均存量~Mean occupancy in elevator waiting
units.title: 電梯等候平均存量~Mean occupancy in elevator waiting
units.mechanism: 本單元以共同入口邊界核對平均等待與排隊人數，將乘車時間和候梯時間分開避免重複計入。穩態平均存量等於平均到達率乘平均停留時間，這是流量與庫存的連結，不需要先指定排隊分布。它不能描述單一尖峰時刻，也不會告訴人群在空間上如何分布；量測窗若仍在快速累積，就不宜直接套用穩態關係。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：穩態同一人群與同一系統邊界的長時間平均。~Use one entrance boundary to compare average wait with queue size, separating travel inside the lift from waiting to avoid double counting. Mean occupancy equals mean arrival rate times mean residence time in steady flow. This connects throughput and inventory without requiring a specific queue distribution. It does not describe one peak instant or spatial distribution, and a rapidly accumulating observation window does not satisfy the steady-state interpretation. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Long-run averages of the same population within one steady system boundary.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=2 persons/s；平均停留時間 waiting=45 s。公式 y=arrival*waiting，代入得 y=90 persons。邊界：穩態同一人群與同一系統邊界的長時間平均。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=2 persons/s; mean residence time waiting=45 s. Formula y=arrival*waiting gives y=90 persons. Boundary: Long-run averages of the same population within one steady system boundary.
units.verify: 使用一致進出邊界估計流率與停留時間，並與獨立區內人數平均值比對。以「電梯等候平均存量」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Estimate flow and residence time using consistent boundaries and compare with an independent mean occupancy count. For mean occupancy in elevator waiting, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把包含站外等待的停留時間乘上站內流率會混用邊界，造成存量高估或低估。回到「電梯等候平均存量」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Combining residence time that includes an outside queue with an inside flow rate mixes boundaries and biases occupancy. Trace the input chain for mean occupancy in elevator waiting. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 平均人數關係能直接預測任何瞬間的最大擁擠程度~A mean occupancy relation directly predicts the maximum crowding at every instant.
units.practice: 只把平均停留時間 waiting 從 45 改成 49.5 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 90 變為 99 persons。先說明「電梯等候平均存量」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only mean residence time waiting from 45 to 49.5 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 90 to 99 persons. Explain the causal direction for mean occupancy in elevator waiting, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 轉角匯流局部密度~Local density at merging corners
units.title: 轉角匯流局部密度~Local density at merging corners
units.mechanism: 本單元觀察轉角、立柱與路徑交叉形成的群聚，對照同面積卻不同幾何配置的密度分布。平均密度是人數除以可用面積，設備、柱體與危險邊緣應從面積中扣除。相同平均密度可以包含完全不同的局部群聚；門口、扶梯出口與轉角的局部高密度，常比整個大廳平均值更能解釋行走速度下降。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：靜態平均密度，不是擠壓力或個別人的安全風險模型。~Observe clustering at corners, columns and crossing paths, comparing density distributions for equal areas with different geometry. Mean density divides people by usable area after excluding equipment, columns and unsafe edges. The same average can conceal very different local clustering. High density at doors, escalator landings or corners often explains reduced walking speed better than the average across a large concourse. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static mean density, not a crowd-pressure or individual-risk model.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：區內人數 people=180 persons；可站立面積 area=90 m2。公式 y=people/area，代入得 y=2 persons/m2。邊界：靜態平均密度，不是擠壓力或個別人的安全風險模型。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupants people=180 persons; usable standing area area=90 m2. Formula y=people/area gives y=2 persons/m2. Boundary: Static mean density, not a crowd-pressure or individual-risk model.
units.verify: 用網格分區計數比較平均與局部尖峰，記錄可用面積隨設備或圍籬變動的情況。以「轉角匯流局部密度」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Count occupants in spatial cells, compare mean and local peaks, and record changes in usable area from equipment or barriers. For local density at merging corners, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 將封閉區域算入面積會低估密度，遮蔽導致漏計又可能恰好發生在最擁擠的地方。回到「轉角匯流局部密度」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Including closed areas understates density; occlusion-related undercounting can be worst precisely where crowding is greatest. Trace the input chain for local density at merging corners. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 整個大廳平均密度低就能保證每個出口都不擁擠~A low concourse-average density guarantees that every exit is uncrowded.
units.practice: 只把可站立面積 area 從 90 改成 99 m2（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變為 1.81818 persons/m2。先說明「轉角匯流局部密度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only usable standing area area from 90 to 99 m2 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2 to 1.81818 persons/m2. Explain the causal direction for local density at merging corners, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 垂直運輸往返節拍~Round-trip vertical-service cycle
units.title: 垂直運輸往返節拍~Round-trip vertical-service cycle
units.mechanism: 本單元把電梯登乘、行進、離開及回程直接列成完整週期，將門動作納入服務時間並區分每小時循環與每小時旅客數。單台電梯往返週期由登乘、行進、離開及回程組成，門動作必須被計入服務階段。理想每小時循環數不等於每小時可服務人數，還需考慮載客量、樓層呼叫、上下行需求與可用性；乘客集中到達時，平均循環有餘裕也可能形成長候梯隊伍。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩樓層串行往返且無中途停靠的理想循環，未含載客量及等待分布。~List elevator boarding, travel, alighting and return directly as one complete cycle, including door actions and distinguishing trips per hour from passengers per hour. An elevator round trip includes boarding, travel, alighting and return, with door actions included in the service phases. Ideal cycles per hour are not passengers per hour: occupancy, floor calls, directional demand and availability also matter. Concentrated passenger arrivals can create long waits even when the mean cycle appears to offer spare capacity. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Ideal serial round trip between two levels without intermediate stops, excluding occupancy and waiting distributions.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：開門登乘及關門 board=18 s；載客行進 travel=24 s；開門離開及關門 alight=16 s；回程時間 return_=24 s。公式 y=3600/(board+travel+alight+return_)，代入得 y=43.9024 trips/h。邊界：兩樓層串行往返且無中途停靠的理想循環，未含載客量及等待分布。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: door and boarding time board=18 s; loaded travel travel=24 s; door and alighting time alight=16 s; return travel return_=24 s. Formula y=3600/(board+travel+alight+return_) gives y=43.9024 trips/h. Boundary: Ideal serial round trip between two levels without intermediate stops, excluding occupancy and waiting distributions.
units.verify: 以同一門開關事件界定各階段，分別記錄登乘與離開，抽查回程空載及途中呼叫是否改變循環邊界。以「垂直運輸往返節拍」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Define stages with consistent door events, record boarding and alighting separately, and inspect whether empty return or intermediate calls change the cycle boundary. For round-trip vertical-service cycle, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 漏算回程會高估循環率，把門動作在兩個階段重複計入則會低估能力；實際載客需求還可能由上游排隊控制。回到「垂直運輸往返節拍」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Omitting return overstates cycle rate, while counting door motion twice understates capacity; actual passenger demand may also be governed by upstream queues. Trace the input chain for round-trip vertical-service cycle. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 電梯每小時往返次數可以直接當作每小時服務人數~Elevator round trips per hour can directly be treated as passengers served per hour.
units.practice: 只把開門登乘及關門 board 從 18 改成 19.8 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 43.9024 變為 42.9594 trips/h。先說明「垂直運輸往返節拍」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only door and boarding time board from 18 to 19.8 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 43.9024 to 42.9594 trips/h. Explain the causal direction for round-trip vertical-service cycle, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 層間辨識與照明~Level identification and lighting
units.title: 層間辨識與照明~Level identification and lighting
units.mechanism: 本單元檢查轉折處照度與指標對比，讓旅客能在到達分流點前辨認正確樓層與方向。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。煙氣、污損與電池老化可能同時降低可見性；指示方向、對比與旅客視力也會影響辨識，不能只用燈具是否亮著作為完成檢核。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。~Check illuminance and sign contrast at turns so travellers can identify the correct level and direction before reaching the route split. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots. Smoke, dirt and battery ageing can reduce visibility together. Directional cues, contrast and eyesight affect recognition, so a lamp being on is not a complete verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。公式 y=flux*util/area，代入得 y=45 lx。邊界：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2. Formula y=flux*util/area gives y=45 lx. Boundary: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values.
units.verify: 以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。以「層間辨識與照明」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions. For level identification and lighting, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 亮度集中在燈具下方可能留下暗區，指示牌反光也可降低遠距離的有效對比。回到「層間辨識與照明」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Light concentrated beneath fixtures leaves dark regions; sign glare can also reduce effective contrast at a distance. Trace the input chain for level identification and lighting. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口~Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
units.practice: 只把光通量 flux 從 2400 改成 2640 lm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45 變為 49.5 lx。先說明「層間辨識與照明」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only luminous flux flux from 2400 to 2640 lm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 45 to 49.5 lx. Explain the causal direction for level identification and lighting, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 電梯停用替代路徑~Alternative routes during lift outages
units.title: 電梯停用替代路徑~Alternative routes during lift outages
units.mechanism: 本單元以角色任務矩陣檢查電梯停用後的可達路徑，不能把需要樓梯的替代線視為所有旅客可用。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Use a user-task matrix to examine accessible routes during a lift outage; a stair-only alternative is not usable by every passenger. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「電梯停用替代路徑」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For alternative routes during lift outages, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「電梯停用替代路徑」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for alternative routes during lift outages. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險~One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
units.practice: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「電梯停用替代路徑」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for alternative routes during lift outages, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 跨層動線驗證安排~Planning multilevel route verification
units.title: 跨層動線驗證安排~Planning multilevel route verification
units.mechanism: 本單元安排不同到達波與設備停用組合的重播，保留初始排隊與協助人員配置以便重現結果。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Plan replay across arrival waves and equipment outages, retaining initial queues and assistance staffing so results can be reproduced. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「跨層動線驗證安排」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For planning multilevel route verification, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「跨層動線驗證安排」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for planning multilevel route verification. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果~All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
units.practice: 只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「跨層動線驗證安排」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for planning multilevel route verification, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
